title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — regulatory identity
summary: FDA/GUDID classification facts for the ACL TOP 350 CTS — device category and premarket submission record, not a clinical claim.

sourceOfTruth.title: AccessGUDID — DEVICE: ACL TOP 350 CTS (08426950784081)
sourceOfTruth.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA GUDID

specifications.label: FDA premarket submissions on record
specifications.note: Two separate submission numbers on file — not yet resolved which covers which configuration or software version; flagged, not assumed.

content.fieldNotes: Regulatory classification only. Does not describe clinical performance, indications, or interpretation — those live in the cleared labeling itself, which hasn't been sourced here. R1-classed on purpose, distinct from the M1 (manufacturer marketing) source on acl350.system-identity — the two shouldn't be merged into one sourceOfTruth even though they describe the same device, which is exactly the multi-source situation the source-hierarchy schema gap (noted in KNOWLEDGE_BLOCK_MODEL.md) doesn't yet handle cleanly.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — sample handling capability
summary: Confirmed sample-handling and pre-analytical check capabilities — what the analyzer does with a loaded tube before testing begins.

specifications.label: HIL sample check
specifications.note: Detects Hemolysis, Icterus, Lipemia interference — an instrument-level interference check, not a clinical interpretation of the result itself.

content.fieldNotes: These are pre-analytical instrument checks — confirms the sample and mechanical path are suitable for testing. Does not describe what happens to a result once calculated; see acl350.results-governance-software for that boundary.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — reagent and consumable capacity
summary: Onboard reagent and consumable capacity and tracking capability.

specifications.label: Barcoded reagents
specifications.value: Yes — barcode encodes lot, expiration date, and vial size

content.fieldNotes: Capacity and identification facts only. Reagent stability-tracking and lot-management workflow mechanics (charter capability 4 items) aren't confirmed from the spec sheet — not claimed here, would need operator-manual sourcing.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — test execution capability
summary: Confirmed test-execution features — predilution, STAT handling, rerun/reflex support.

specifications.label: STAT capability
specifications.value: Yes — at any time, in any position

specifications.label: Rerun and reflex testing
specifications.note: Configurable means lab-defined rules, not a Translate-asserted clinical rule — rule content itself isn't sourced here.

content.fieldNotes: Describes what the instrument supports doing, not when a lab should choose to do it — that's a lab policy decision, out of scope per the Translate Scope Constitution.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — measurement method categories and throughput
summary: Confirmed analytical method categories and throughput figures. Internal measurement sequence, optical channels, and calculation algorithms are explicitly not claimed.

content.fieldNotes: Per the Research Charter's explicit restraint on capability 6: internal measurement sequence, optical channel detail, timing logic, and calculation algorithms are not claimed here — not yet supported by any source reviewed. Throughput is a published spec figure, not a description of the internal method.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — results governance (software mechanics only)
summary: What the software does with a result once calculated — storage, autovalidation, audit trail. Explicitly excludes reference ranges, abnormal-flag significance, and any clinical interpretation, per the Scope Constitution.

specifications.label: Results autovalidation
specifications.note: Describes that an autovalidation feature exists and can act on results — the rules it applies are lab-configured, not sourced or asserted here.

content.fieldNotes: This is the capability most likely to carry the Scope Constitution's boundary inside it rather than around it (see TRANSLATE_SCOPE_CONSTITUTION.md, 'How this binds domain charters'). Deliberately excludes reference ranges, abnormal-flag significance, and result interpretation — those describe clinical meaning, not software behavior, and are out of scope regardless of whether Werfen's own materials discuss them elsewhere.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — host/LIS communication capability
summary: Confirmed host-communication capability. Protocol-level detail (message types, HL7 version in use) is not yet sourced — flagged as the connection point to the hl7-v2/FHIR domain, not assumed.

content.fieldNotes: The spec sheet confirms bidirectional host communication exists but doesn't name a protocol or message standard. Linked to hl7v2.msh-segment as a plausible connection, not a confirmed one — whether this analyzer's host interface actually uses HL7 v2, and which version, needs its own sourced answer before that link is treated as more than a hypothesis.

title: ACL TOP 350 CTS — security and access-control features
summary: Confirmed existence of security-relevant features per the manufacturer spec sheet. Does not confirm current hardening posture, patch level, or configuration of any deployed unit.

content.fieldNotes: This block is the concrete first application of LAB_EQUIPMENT_DOMAIN_TEMPLATE.md's 'third risk axis' note: confirming a feature exists on a 2017-dated spec sheet is not the same claim as confirming current patch level, hardening configuration, or cybersecurity posture on any actual deployed unit. Werfen does maintain a dedicated cybersecurity/product-privacy channel (werfen.com/na/en/cybersecurity) — not yet sourced into this block, and should be before any claim stronger than 'this feature category exists' gets made here.
